triggers.detailsText: Terminals (India) Private Limited, a subsidiary in which Accuracy Shipping Limited holds a 99.80% stake, has received a Letter of Intent (LoI) dated September 10, 2026, from the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) for setting up a Container Freight Station (CFS) at Kandla, Gujarat.
